Question: jume ki namaaz main sunnate muakkda kitni hai or us ki padhne ki tarteeb kya hai? Answer ID: 12009 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 601/427=L/1430) There are four rak?ah sunnah muakkadah before Jumua?h, while after Jumu?ah also it is four, but according to Imam Abu Yusuf and Imam Muhammad it is six: یستن بعدھا أربعاً أو ستا علی الخلاف أي أربعاً عندہ و ستا عندھما (الشامی 3:436 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
